statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ trades 29,448.50, +0.66%, 28.50 points below a 29,477.00 session high, with the 29,247.75 post-FOMC reopen low untested for a third consecutive assessment hour. That persistence keeps Tail in the watch band at 20, but it does not lift it further, because the hourly extension has decayed from roughly 90 points to about 14 and the amplifier stack is not aligning: the dollar index is flat at 100.30 on a 13 basis-point range, the Nikkei 225 has retraced about 410 points from its own session high, VIX closed at 17.71, and WTI is easing to $102.11. Stress rises one point to 71 because the Saudi East-West pipeline restart that had been priced as imminent is not confirmed by Aramco or the Saudi Energy Ministry. Tail remains below the block threshold.
recommendation: Two readings pull in opposite directions this hour, and the state holds rather than moves. The 29,247.75 low has now survived three full hours untested while price continues to sit within 30 points of the session high, which is the shallow-pullback signature a mean-reversion basket is most exposed to and the reason the watch band is retained. Against that, the leg has stopped extending: it added about 14 points in the past hour after roughly 90 in the one before, it spans 0.78% of index value in the thinnest liquidity of the day, it recovers Wednesday's Fed-day decline rather than breaking into new territory, and no second amplifier has joined it. The dollar is quiet, Asian equities have already retraced, volatility pricing is subdued and crude is drifting lower. The one component that has genuinely worsened is informational rather than structural: reporting now indicates the pipeline restart rests on an optimistic assessment from the US Energy Secretary that diverges from press estimates, with no Saudi technical assessment published, so the crude supply premium could re-widen on a gap rather than on a path. The mapped danger window covers 12:30 to 14:30 UTC, spanning the bundled claims, housing starts, permits and Philadelphia Fed release at 12:30 UTC and the cash open at 13:30 UTC. Forecast Tail peaks at 23 across that span and no slot reaches the block threshold, because no post-release price path has been observed.
headline: NQ holds 29,448.50 with the 29,247.75 reopen low untested a third hour, but extension stalls to +14 points, keeping Tail at 20 while an unconfirmed pipeline restart lifts Stress to 71
body:
The FOMC raised the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 3-3/4 to 4 percent at 18:00 UTC on 16 September in a unanimous 12-0 vote, the first increase in three years, judging that activity is expanding solidly while inflation remains elevated and framing the move as supporting a timelier return to the 2 percent goal. Cash markets closed split: the Nasdaq-100 finished at 28,945.06, up 0.02%, after a 28,753.29-29,235.89 range, while the Dow fell about 1.2%. The 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.01%, its highest since 2007, against a 4.94-5.01% day range; the H.15 release for 15 September shows the 2-year at 4.67% and the 10-year at 5.00%. VIX closed at 17.71, up 2.97%.

Since the Globex reopen the futures path has stayed one-directional in shape but has lost force. NQ has traded 29,247.75-29,477.00, a 229.25-point band worth 0.78% of index value, and now sits at 29,448.50 as of 01:15 UTC, 28.50 points under the high, with the low untested across three consecutive assessment hours. The high advanced only 12.25 points over the past hour and price added about 14, against roughly 90 in the hour before. That deceleration is why the persistent structure holds the watch band without escalating it. Cross-asset confirmation is absent rather than building: the dollar index sits at 100.30, up 0.05% on a 13 basis-point range; the Nikkei 225 trades 64,233.94, up 0.49%, but roughly 410 points below its 64,643.58 session high, so the nearest correlated equity market has already retraced; WTI is $102.11, down 0.31%, with Brent $105.82.

The energy leg of the picture has become less settled rather than more. Reporting on 16 September indicates the Saudi East-West pipeline remains shut after the 10 September drone attacks, that an optimistic restart assessment came from the US Energy Secretary and diverges from press estimates of a longer timeline, and that neither Saudi Aramco nor the Saudi Energy Ministry has published a technical assessment of repair or restart capacity. The supply premium that carried crude above $100 is therefore unwinding on an unconfirmed claim, which is a gap-risk mechanism rather than an observed price path, and it accounts for the one-point rise in Stress to 71. Latest-session Nasdaq internals remain mixed rather than aligned, with megacaps split five up and three down at a -0.11% mean and semiconductors firmer at a +0.82% mean.

The next scheduled catalysts are the 12:30 UTC block of initial jobless claims, housing starts, building permits and the Philadelphia Fed index, with published consensus near 208k claims, followed by the 13:30 UTC cash open and pending home sales at 14:00 UTC. The Bank of Japan concludes a two-day meeting on 18 September with its policy rate at 0.75%, a yen-channel checkpoint beyond this forecast window. Shared Finviz cross-asset context was only partially collected for this run, with the futures and calendar sections unavailable, so futures levels, yields, crude and the calendar were sourced independently from primary references.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 published Claude hours span a complete FOMC cycle and all 24 are available from published history, none restated with later information. The state ran 13-16 in the low band with a normal dominant mode through the Asian and European sessions of 16 September, with no observed directional structure. It entered the watch band at 12:00 UTC alongside the US pre-market and held 20-22 through the early afternoon as positioning built, reaching 24 in the 18:00 UTC statement hour. The single orange print came at 19:00 UTC, Tail 31 with a trend-down mode, during the press conference and the yield-led equity leg. That resolved quickly: 20 by 20:00 UTC as the move turned two-sided, then 18 and 16 as cash closed and volatility decayed, then 18 with a trend-up mode at 23:00 UTC as the reopen leg began, and 20 at 00:00 UTC once the leg had extended twice without retracing. Stress stayed in the high band throughout, between 70 and 79, and Confidence held 87-89.
outlookSummary: The forecast opens at 20 for the current hour, the only slot backed by observed price-path structure, holds 20 through the Asian mid-session while the untested-low read remains live, then eases to an 18 trough between 04:00 and 06:00 UTC as the leg ages out of its thin-liquidity window. It firms to 19 across the European cash open and morning, where continental desks price the hike and a 5.01% ten-year for the first time, and steps to 20 in the hour before the US data block. The 12:00 to 14:00 UTC slots carry the highest conditional readings at 22, 23 and 23, spanning the bundled 12:30 UTC release, the 13:30 UTC cash open and pending home sales at 14:00 UTC; the mapped danger window matches that span at 12:30 to 14:30 UTC. No slot reaches the block threshold, because a post-release continuation path is conditional and unobserved. The path then decays through the US afternoon to 19, firms to 20 for the 20:00 UTC power hour on closing-auction flow, troughs at 17 overnight and lifts to 18 for the 00:00 UTC Globex reopen. Stress stays in the high band throughout, easing from 71 to a 66 overnight floor and peaking at 74 at the cash open, while Confidence declines from 86 to 64 as the horizon extends beyond observed evidence.
